subject: Discovery follow-up: demo scheduling / reschedule
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@acmeanalytics.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery follow-up: demo scheduling

Hi Sara & Tom,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation on your vector search + embedding use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: current infra is on AWS with DynamoDB for metadata, embeddings stored in S3; main pain points are latency at scale and cost leakage from per-request inference.
- Who should be on the demo: Tom (search owner), Sara (product), plus engineering (suggested: Dev Patel from our infra team).
- Goal for next call: technical deep-dive and live demo of Redwood’s Dedicated routing + caching flow, and a short pricing/operational primer.

Proposed times (PT):
- Thu Mar 4, 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Fri Mar 5, 2:00–3:00 PM PT

I attached the discovery notes and a short proposed agenda. If neither slot works, please share 2–3 windows next week and we’ll confirm. I’ll send a calendar invite once we lock a time.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
